verdict.rationale: Supabase provides genuine building blocks for autonomous background automation: Cron for scheduled Postgres/Edge Function jobs, Database Webhooks for event-triggered actions, Queues for durable async task processing, and MCP tooling explicitly designed for 'unattended monitoring routines' with read-only/scoped guardrails. However, this is DIY infrastructure requiring the user to wire together cron+webhooks+queues+edge functions themselves rather than a turnkey 'set up an automation' feature, and the MCP docs explicitly caution that unattended agents must be pre-scoped to read-only/limited tools since they can't request approval mid-run, implying real risk/limitation for full autonomy. missing for 10: a first-party unified 'automation builder' UI/API tying triggers to agent actions, hands-on evidence of an autonomous agent running unattended in production, and independent confirmation these primitives compose reliably for full agentic autonomy.
